# Listing copy — LS-8-LIFE

## Teachers Pay Teachers — title
Grade 8 English: Private Life — 122 terms for LingoSpark games | Paste into vocab games (Bomb, Flashcards, Live Quiz)

## TPT — description (EN)
Grade-8 Private life module: family, friends, daily routine, free time. Paste-ready LingoSpark lists.

This pack is built for Polish exam English (Polish Grade-8 English Exam, A2–B1, topic: Private life and free time).

**122 exam-style terms** in 7 lesson sets of about 20 (one 45-minute lesson per set).

Each term has:
- a Polish gloss (paste into games so students type the English word)
- an English definition (harder mode / Matura-style)
- a natural example sentence (used in the gap-fill)

**How it works with LingoSpark (free vocab games):**
1. Copy a paste file (term = definition).
2. Open https://lingospark.study → Vocab Review.
3. Paste into Bomb Defusal, Classic Flashcards, Grid Territory, Vocab Auction, Live Vocab Quiz.
4. Play. No extra software.

Printable worksheets (matching, gap-fill, mini-quiz) plus a full answer key are included as HTML — print to PDF from your browser (Ctrl+P → Save as PDF).

Vocab games on LingoSpark stay free. You do not need a paid Writing Suite account to use this pack.

**Not included:** the site’s free “Człowiek” demo lists. This is original Private life and free time content.

Licence: one teacher, one classroom. Do not post the paste files on a public drive.

Suggested price: USD 5.5

## TPT tags

## Polish teacher groups / Facebook
Ósmoklasista: Życie prywatne — 122 haseł do gier LingoSpark

Dział Życie prywatne: rodzina, znajomi, rutyna dnia, czas wolny. Listy do gier LingoSpark + karty.

122 haseł (A2–B1), 7 lekcji. Wklejasz do darmowych gier na https://lingospark.study (bomba, fiszki, aukcja, live quiz). Karty do druku + klucz.

Cena sugerowana: 22 zł (plik ZIP).

Licencja: jedna osoba / jedna klasa. Nie wrzucaj plików na Librus „dla całej szkoły” ani na grupę FB.
